predicted_measurement: Prospective claim: compact expression of the arbitrary-member versus uniform-draw distinction, with demonstrated preservation of comprehension on the named current reader panel. This is not a claim of superior comprehension or of human-population performance. Primary carrier: token_delta, strictly below zero for each of cl100k_base and o200k_base and for each form, on 128 preregistered fresh complete pairs, 64 per form, comparing the marked request with its full author-approved careful-English mapping span in identical shared context. Retain all per-tokenizer and per-form results. This establishes cost only against the declared mapping, not against the shortest adequate English expression, nor future tokenizer or training benefits. Comprehension prerequisite: a separate prospective fixed study of 6144 fresh distinct semantic worlds, 3072 per form, with two qualified, fixed editions of Gemma 3 12B and Mistral Small 3.2 24B. Each reader receives one preregistered wording arm per world and answers the held-out policy/guarantee consequence task; preserve the exact approved mapping-span rendering and common deduplication explanation. The full sampler, questions, ordered options, golds, actual allocation and request bytes must be frozen before any target inference. Domain is sampled with equal probability from the six declared domains, rather than fixed pooled binomial cells; the inferential scope is the frozen task generator and named readers. No outcome-dependent enlargement, model replacement or reroll. For EACH reader and EACH form, compute one-sided exact binomial lower Ainglish-accuracy and upper English-accuracy bounds with tail 0.025 each. Preservation passes only if their difference exceeds -0.05 and the Ainglish lower bound is at least 0.90. All four reader/form tests must pass, plus the original and independent fresh-world replication must each meet the prespecified scientific decision. The five-percentage-point margin is a proposed retained upper limit from the prior claim, requiring explicit author/reviewer acceptance; it is not proof of exact equality, and no confirmed comprehension-loss veto is waived. Report domain, frame, policy and guarantee diagnostics; a wrong-pole or unwarranted-guarantee error rate above 10% in any predeclared offered-contrast cell with at least 200 opportunities prevents support and requires review. Missing/invalid responses are never silently dropped; no preservation pass is reported for an incomplete execution. REFUTED by independently confirmed comprehension harm under the standing rules, by a confidence bound establishing loss beyond five points or absolute accuracy below 90%, or by independently supported violation of the declared safety boundary; non-saving token results refute the compactness carrier. An interval that cannot establish preservation is INCONCLUSIVE, not proof of inferiority. The official CAD statistic, resolution label, adverse outcomes and replication decision remain visible unchanged beside the prospective analysis. Current API schema acceptance does not enact a noninferiority or confirmation rule: launch requires an explicit governed recognition path and author-approved final study. Bare-random ambiguity and post-ratification independent usage remain separately reported and unmeasured until actually studied; neither is claimed established by this study.
